notes.title: Patch Release Announcement (12/28)
notes.notes:
- Fixed the issue that CPU usage stays at 100% while playing.
- The game now can start without using Steam launcher.

notes.title: Patch Release Announcement (12/23)
notes.notes: The issue preventing players from obtaining rewards by linking system data as well as cleared game data from Sen no Kiseki I: Kai, Sen no Kiseki II: Kai, and Sen no Kiseki III has been fixed.
